source.discussion: maintainer field report: owner-facing browser surfaces

pattern: open a page for the user without claiming automation control
experience: An agent opened a requested dashboard with preview_open, requiring the user to take control repeatedly.
rule: use purpose user for a new visible user-facing tab
prompt: The dashboard is already hosted at https://dashboard.example/. Open it in my right side panel for me to use now. I should be able to scroll, click and type immediately and keep using it across focus changes. Do not make me find a link or pre-open a tab.

source.discussion: maintainer field report: owner-facing browser surfaces

pattern: QA tabs remain agent-owned and background
experience: Agent QA needs exclusive control without repurposing the user workspace.
rule: keep ordinary QA on a separate background automation tab
prompt: I have an unrelated dashboard open for my own use. Open a separate background QA tab at https://app.example/ to inspect the app. Do not show it to me or change my dashboard. Just open the QA tab for now.
